brief_summary: Five-row, four-column grid — one row per Boba member (U4T, U4, U4Tx, LT, Bobagum), columns for stem, dampening, spring weight, and voice — with a left-margin bracket labelled 'one housing blend' spanning all rows. The three undampened-floor members (U4T, U4Tx, LT) get coral voice cells; the two silent members read 'near silent' in warm grey. Renders the article's 'matrix of subtractions' framing literally.
